measurements.hypothesis: The unchanged mixed product leaves its selected clients in DHCP mode on link-local addresses with the server enabled.
One typed explicit start or mode reassertion, unlike no intervention, makes a link-local DHCP client acquire an attributed lease from its intended pool.
Router tables, client bindings and every physical pool are observed before cleanup.
